notes: This file tracks whether current active diagnostics are driven by corpus material, MS-VBAL/spec evidence, or oracle observations.
Legacy Markdown corpus files are pending-verification and must not be used as sole evidence for hard diagnostics.
Observed-only oracle cases may guide discovery, but they do not justify hard analyzer behavior until promoted.

diagnostics.notes: Project-backed unknown-call uses ProjectIndex.visibleProcedureNames(moduleName), so only same-module procedures and exported standard-module procedures are treated as bare callable names. Private procedures in other modules and object-module members do not suppress the diagnostic.

Active rule covers project-backed bare assignment and Set targets under Option Explicit. Broader read references and indexed targets remain deferred until the expression binder has enough built-in constant/global coverage to avoid false positives.

diagnostics.sourceOfTruth: MS-VBAL 5.4.2.1 plus asserted Excel/VBE oracle cases plus deterministic project signature graph
diagnostics.notes: Same-module signatures come from the AST. Cross-module checks run only for exported standard-module Sub/Function signatures supplied by ProjectIndex. Ambiguous bare exported names stay silent; module-qualified calls resolve through the named standard module only.

diagnostics.sourceOfTruth: Excel/VBE compile and runtime oracle plus deterministic XLIDE literal, return-type, numeric-expression, string-concatenation, and project signature model
diagnostics.notes: This is not a VBE compile-equivalent error: the focused compile oracle case compiles successfully. It is red because focused runtime oracle cases deterministically raise runtime error 13 for nonnumeric string literals passed to numeric parameters, while numeric-string controls run successfully. Cross-module checks use exported standard-module project Sub/Function signatures; ambiguous bare names stay silent, while module-qualified calls resolve through the named standard module only.

diagnostics.sourceOfTruth: Excel/VBE compile oracle plus deterministic XLIDE object-parameter compatibility model
diagnostics.notes: This is a VBE compile-equivalent error: the focused oracle case is rejected with Type mismatch.

diagnostics.sourceOfTruth: Excel/VBE compile and runtime oracle plus deterministic XLIDE scalar assignment compatibility model
diagnostics.notes: This is not a VBE compile-equivalent error: focused compile oracle cases compile successfully. It is red when XLIDE proves a literal cannot be coerced because focused runtime oracle cases deterministically raise runtime error 13, while numeric/string/Boolean/property/public-field controls run successfully.

diagnostics.sourceOfTruth: Excel/VBE compile oracle plus deterministic source-backed project class member model
diagnostics.notes: This is a VBE compile-equivalent error when the receiver resolves to a workbook class and source proves the member has no setter. Public constants are not object members in VBE; public constant declarations in object modules fail at the declaration.

diagnostics.sourceOfTruth: Excel/VBE compile oracle plus deterministic source-backed project class member model
diagnostics.notes: This is a VBE compile-equivalent error for workbook class receivers whose source-backed member surface is known and unambiguous. Public fields are valid members. Host/object-model and ambiguous receiver cases remain silent unless the receiver surface is exhaustive. Host events are not callable object members, so event names are excluded from object-member surfaces and can be reported absent when the receiver surface is exhaustive. Object and Variant receivers remain silent even when completion can refine them from simple Set assignments because VBE leaves those calls late-bound.

diagnostics.sourceOfTruth: Excel/VBE runtime oracle plus deterministic XLIDE numeric-expression compatibility model
diagnostics.notes: This is an error but not VBE compile-equivalent: the focused compile oracle case compiles successfully, while runtime oracle probes for nonnumeric string arithmetic deterministically raise runtime error 13. Operand-order, grouping, and multiplication variants reject; numeric-string, &-concatenation, and string-plus-string + controls run successfully.

diagnostics.sourceOfTruth: MS-VBAL 5.4.2.1 plus asserted Excel/VBE oracle case for bare variable statement
diagnostics.notes: The argument-bearing local-variable call shape is observed-only until promoted; the active rule remains justified by call-statement target resolution.

diagnostics.sourceOfTruth: MS-VBAL 5.2.3.1 plus asserted Excel/VBE oracle case for a trailing identifier after an As type name
diagnostics.notes: The active rule only fires after XLIDE parses a complete declaration type name and then sees an additional same-statement token outside valid declaration separators/defaults. Fixed-length string syntax remains out of scope until its full grammar is verified.

diagnostics.sourceOfTruth: Excel/VBE compile oracle for public object-module declaration restrictions
diagnostics.notes: The active rule is module-kind-sensitive and only fires for explicit Public constants, arrays, fixed-length strings, user-defined Types, and Declare statements in object modules. Standard modules and non-public declarations remain outside this rule.

diagnostics.sourceOfTruth: Excel/VBE compile oracle plus MS-VBAL reserved-name/type-identifier distinction
diagnostics.notes: Broad unknown As-type diagnostics are deferred to the project-wide binder; this rule only flags reserved runtime functions that cannot be valid type names.

diagnostics.sourceOfTruth: Excel/VBE compile oracle plus deterministic XLIDE scalar variable type environment
diagnostics.notes: Only known intrinsic scalar targets are flagged; unknown host/class object types are deferred to the object binder.

diagnostics.sourceOfTruth: Excel/VBE compile and runtime oracle plus deterministic XLIDE scalar variable type environment
diagnostics.notes: Named member access on declared intrinsic scalar variables is rejected by VBE Compile as Invalid qualifier. Bare trailing-dot scalar statements are rejected by VBE Compile as Syntax error after explicit focus retesting. Only known intrinsic scalar receivers are flagged; Variant, Object, class, UDT, and unknown receiver types stay silent while they may be incomplete member-access completion contexts.

diagnostics.sourceOfTruth: MS-VBAL 5.4.2.1 plus asserted Excel/VBE oracle cases for standalone empty-parentheses member calls without Call
diagnostics.notes: VBE rejects standalone zero-argument member/property statements such as ThisWorkbook.CanCheckIn(), Application.Calculate(), and ActiveSheet.Range() when they use empty parentheses without Call, while the same parenthesized member call is valid in expression context or with the explicit Call keyword. VBE also accepts non-empty standalone member/property forms such as Application.DeleteCustomList(1) and ActiveSheet.Range("A1"), so the active rule is deliberately scoped to the empty-parentheses form.
